scenario.description: Ctrl F in the stream (PLAN §18.1, DESIGN §4.1): the find bar searches every file of the review, both sides: a match inside a collapsed gap opens the gap around it, a file below the viewport not loaded yet loads for the search, a binary file is counted as not searched, a viewed (collapsed) file opens for its match; Enter and Shift Enter go through the matches wrapping, smart case, No results, Esc closes and gives the keyboard back to the stream; screenshots in dark Mica and light.
